name: Set a scenario or per-flow performance budget
description: Declare a performance budget threshold for a scenario (build/bundle/startup/LCP/component-commit) or, with --flow, for one interaction journey (LCP + component-commit). Add --ratchet to make the budget tighten-only. Budgets gate via baseline-diff: a regression past a declared axis fails the next diff exactly like any other health regression.

flow.description: Interaction-flow slug for a per-flow budget; empty = scenario-level.

lcp_max_ms.description: Max Largest Contentful Paint in milliseconds (one axis; see `budget set --help` for the rest).

examples.description: Set a 2500ms LCP budget on the scroll-library flow.
